chunks.text: First-in, first-out (FIFO) assumes the oldest inventory costs are sold first. In periods of rising prices, FIFO usually leaves newer costs in ending inventory.
Inventory turnover equals cost of goods sold divided by average inventory. A higher turnover can indicate inventory is sold more frequently.
